content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Intermediate or equivalent (minimum); Merit is prepared on the basis of qualifications up to postgraduate level; Only women candidates are eligible Age limit: 18 to 35 years (as on 1 July 2026) Other conditions: Only women candidates are eligible Candidate must be a resident of the same gram sabha / ward (urban areas) as the Anganwadi centre, as per the preference order Income certificate must be verifiable online and issued within three years before 14-12-2026 Income, caste and residence certificates issued after 14-12-2026 are not valid

content_sections.heading: How Will District Programme Officer, ICDS, Ballia Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit prepared on the basis of educational qualification up to postgraduate level Preference order among residents of the same gram sabha / ward as laid down in the notice Selection as per the provisions of the Government Order dated 17.09.2025 Preference: widow / legally divorced / abandoned woman of a BPL family of the same gram sabha / ward Next: women of BPL families of the same gram sabha / ward If none is eligible in the gram sabha, category-wise selection from the concerned Nyay Panchayat Right to cancel any selection rests with the selection committee / appointing authority

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Programme Officer, ICDS, Ballia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Programme Officer, ICDS, Ballia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 486 vacancies for Anganwadi Sahayika.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Programme Officer, ICDS, Ballia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years (as on 1 July 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum Intermediate or equivalent. The merit list is prepared on the basis of qualifications up to postgraduate level. Only women candidates are eligible.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only women candidates are eligible. Candidate must be a resident of the same gram sabha / ward (urban areas) as the Anganwadi centre, as per the preference order. Income certificate must be verifiable online and issued within three years before 14-12-2026. Income, caste and residence certificates issued after 14-12-2026 are not valid.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Two women of one family will not be appointed at one Anganwadi centre. Offline applications are not accepted in any case.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit prepared on the basis of educational qualification up to postgraduate level. Preference order among residents of the same gram sabha / ward as laid down in the notice. Selection as per the provisions of the Government Order dated 17.09.2025. Preference: widow / legally divorced / abandoned woman of a BPL family of the same gram sabha / ward.

faq.answer: 18 child development projects of Ballia district: Bairia, Bansdih, Belhari, Beruarbari, City, Chilkahar, Dubhad, Garwar, Hanumanganj, Maniar, Murlichhapra, Nagra, Navanagar, Pandah, Rasra, Reoti, Siyar, Sohav.
